vi: Viết Terraform khai báo RDS Postgres + Aurora cluster với Serverless v2 auto-scaling, chạy terraform validate để xác minh schema engine_version, instance_class, throughput_mode.
Phân biệt RDS single-AZ vs Multi-AZ vs Aurora: RDS Multi-AZ sync replication <30s failover; Aurora cluster tách storage-compute, <10s failover nhờ storage-compute separation.
Enable Multi-AZ trên RDS Postgres qua Terraform, force failover rồi đo downtime thực tế, so sánh với Aurora failover bằng pgbench benchmark.
Cấu hình Aurora Serverless v2 với min_capacity/max_capacity auto-scale theo load, hiểu vì sao không có free-tier cho Aurora.
Thiết kế RPO/RTO requirement theo workload, chọn đúng topology: single-AZ tối tiểu cost, Multi-AZ cho production HA, Aurora cho cần failover <10s.
en: Write Terraform declaring RDS Postgres plus Aurora cluster with Serverless v2 auto-scaling, run terraform validate to verify schema for engine_version, instance_class, and throughput_mode.
Distinguish RDS single-AZ vs Multi-AZ vs Aurora: RDS Multi-AZ has synchronous replication with <30s failover; Aurora clusters separate compute from storage, <10s failover thanks to that separation.
Enable Multi-AZ on RDS Postgres via Terraform, force a failover and measure the actual downtime, compare against Aurora failover using pgbench benchmarks.
Configure Aurora Serverless v2 with min_capacity and max_capacity to auto-scale with load; understand why Aurora has no free tier.
Design RPO/RTO requirements from your workload, pick the right topology: single-AZ for minimum cost, Multi-AZ for production HA, Aurora for sub-10s failover.
